description: New RBI circular on digital payments issued mid-project and its impact on the payments programme not yet assessed
mitigation: Run a regulatory impact assessment with the compliance team, update requirements and the plan, and get compliance sign-off before go-live

description: Updated KYC norms require extra customer verification fields not covered in the current onboarding design
mitigation: Map the new KYC requirements to the design, add the missing fields and validations, and retest the onboarding journey with compliance

description: Regulatory reporting deadline at risk because report data mappings are incomplete
mitigation: Prioritise the report mappings, assign a dedicated data analyst, run a dry run of the report, and inform the regulator liaison early if a delay is likely

description: Customer data stored outside India in a cloud test environment against data localisation requirements
mitigation: Move the data to an India-region environment, mask customer data in non-production, and add a localisation check to the release checklist

description: AML transaction monitoring rules not updated for the new payment product
mitigation: Define monitoring scenarios with the AML team, configure and test the rules before launch, and schedule a post-launch tuning review

description: Audit found that user access reviews for the core banking system were not done on time
mitigation: Complete the overdue access review, remove unneeded access, and automate quarterly access review reminders with owner sign-off

description: Penetration test found high-severity vulnerabilities in the mobile banking login module
mitigation: Fix the vulnerabilities before release, retest with the security team, and add security testing to every release cycle

description: Real customer data used in the UAT environment without masking
mitigation: Stop using unmasked data, apply data masking to all non-production copies, and restrict UAT access to named users

description: Weak API authentication between the payment gateway and the core banking system
mitigation: Introduce mutual TLS and token-based authentication, rotate shared secrets, and add API security tests

description: Phishing attempt on project team members using a fake vendor email
mitigation: Alert the team, report to the information security team, run phishing awareness training, and verify vendor requests through known contacts

description: Privileged admin passwords for servers shared among the project team
mitigation: Move admin access to a privileged access management tool, give individual accounts, and log all privileged sessions

description: Customer data exposed through a misconfigured cloud storage bucket in the test environment
mitigation: Lock down the storage immediately, review access logs, inform the security team, and add cloud configuration scanning to the pipeline

description: Core banking data migration produced mismatched customer balances in the trial run
mitigation: Reconcile balances record by record, fix the transformation rules, run another trial migration, and get finance sign-off before cutover

description: Data migration to the new loan system lost customer records during testing
mitigation: Compare record counts at each step, fix the failed mappings, add automated reconciliation, and keep the old system available as fallback

description: Payment switch performance drops at peak transaction volumes during load testing
mitigation: Tune the switch configuration, add capacity, rerun load tests at peak plus margin, and agree a throttling plan for festival peaks

description: System integration testing environment unavailable for several days blocking regression testing
mitigation: Escalate to infrastructure, set up a backup test environment, and add environment monitoring and a support rota

description: Interface between the mobile app and core banking fails for some account types
mitigation: Identify the failing account types, fix the interface mapping, and add those account types to the regression test pack

description: Batch job for end-of-day interest calculation overruns its processing window
mitigation: Analyse slow steps, optimise queries, run the job in parallel where possible, and agree a fallback schedule with operations

description: Payment gateway vendor has not shared final API documentation delaying integration
mitigation: Escalate to the vendor account manager, agree a firm date, start with sandbox APIs, and track the dependency in steering meetings

description: SMS provider for OTP messages had an outage and customers could not log in
mitigation: Add a backup SMS provider with automatic failover, agree service levels with penalties, and monitor OTP delivery rates

description: Third-party payment vendor failed a security audit
mitigation: Require a remediation plan with dates, restrict the vendor's access until fixed, and review the vendor risk assessment

description: Core banking product vendor delays the patch needed for go-live
mitigation: Escalate through the vendor contract, agree a delivery date, plan a workaround, and assess the impact on the go-live date

description: Vendor resources for the card management system changed without knowledge transfer
mitigation: Ask the vendor for a handover plan, hold knowledge-transfer sessions, and add key-person clauses to the contract

description: Cloud hosting provider maintenance window clashes with the planned go-live weekend
mitigation: Confirm the maintenance schedule with the provider, move the go-live or the maintenance, and keep a rollback plan ready

description: Regulatory go-live date at risk because development is behind schedule
mitigation: Re-plan with critical path analysis, add resources to critical tasks, cut non-essential scope, and report the risk early to sponsors

description: User acceptance testing sign-off delayed because business testers are unavailable
mitigation: Agree dedicated tester time with business heads, prepare test scripts in advance, and run focused UAT sessions

description: Core banking upgrade delayed by three months due to vendor and testing issues
mitigation: Agree a revised plan with the vendor, run testing in parallel where possible, and communicate the new date to stakeholders

description: Release freeze during financial year-end reduces the time available for deployment
mitigation: Plan the release outside the freeze window, prepare deployment early, and get approval for any exception in advance

description: Dependency on another programme's API delivery puts our integration timeline at risk
mitigation: Agree delivery dates with the other programme, use mock APIs for early testing, and track the dependency weekly

description: Change advisory board approval for production deployment delayed
mitigation: Submit the change request early with complete test evidence and a rollback plan, and book the next available approval slot

description: Budget overrun in the digital banking app development due to extra change requests
mitigation: Review change requests against the budget, prioritise must-haves, and get sponsor approval for additional funding or scope cuts

description: Cloud hosting costs above budget because unused test servers were left running
mitigation: Shut down unused servers, schedule non-production environments to stop at night, and set cost alerts

description: Software licence costs increased after the vendor changed its pricing model
mitigation: Negotiate with the vendor, review the number of licences needed, and update the budget forecast

description: Rupee depreciation increased the cost of foreign vendor contracts
mitigation: Review contracts priced in foreign currency, agree fixed rates where possible, and add a contingency to the budget

description: Additional security testing required by audit was not included in the budget
mitigation: Raise a budget change request, prioritise the testing by risk, and plan it into the next release

description: Programme contingency budget almost used up halfway through delivery
mitigation: Review remaining risks and costs, reduce non-essential spend, and agree with sponsors how further overruns will be funded

description: Two senior developers resigned and knowledge of the settlement module is not documented
mitigation: Run urgent knowledge-transfer sessions, document the module, hire or reassign replacements, and pair new staff with remaining experts

description: No AML domain expert available on the project team
mitigation: Request an AML specialist from the compliance team, or engage a consultant for design reviews and testing

description: Key relationship manager resigned during the customer migration phase
mitigation: Assign a replacement quickly, hand over open customer issues, and inform affected customers of the new contact

description: Testers shared across several programmes so testing capacity is limited
mitigation: Agree a fixed testing allocation with the test manager, automate regression tests, and plan testing peaks in advance

description: Business subject-matter experts unavailable because of year-end workload
mitigation: Book expert time early, prepare questions in advance, and use shorter focused workshops

description: Single person holds all production deployment knowledge
mitigation: Document the deployment steps, train a second person, and automate the deployment where possible

description: Business keeps adding new features to the loan origination system after design sign-off
mitigation: Introduce formal change control, assess the impact of each request, and move non-essential features to a later release

description: Loan application screen design not approved by the business team
mitigation: Hold a design review with decision-makers, agree acceptance criteria, and set a sign-off deadline

description: Requirements for the credit card rewards module are unclear and keep changing
mitigation: Run requirement workshops, document agreed requirements with sign-off, and track changes through change control

description: Regulatory change adds new reporting fields that were not in the original scope
mitigation: Assess the impact, raise a change request, adjust the plan and budget, and prioritise the regulatory items

description: Mobile banking release includes features not tested end to end
mitigation: Remove untested features from the release or delay them, and complete end-to-end testing before go-live

description: Branch teams request extra reports not covered in the project scope
mitigation: Record the requests, assess the effort, and plan them for a later phase with sponsor approval
